protocol.singleIndependentVariable: For baseline-supported candidates whose deterministic passage-support reason is PASSAGE_TEXT_SUPPORT or PASSAGE_CUE_SUPPORT, require an exact QA-proposed visible span and multilingual NLI entailment of a generic question-plus-answer hypothesis. Non-PASSAGE deterministic support is preserved. The candidate is a strict subset of baseline support and can never create support.

nliHypothesisTemplates.EN: The answer to the question "<QUESTION>" is "<ANSWER>".
nliHypothesisTemplates.ES: La respuesta a la pregunta "<QUESTION>" es "<ANSWER>".

protocol.sourcePremise: Shortest source sentence containing the exact QA-proposed span.

developmentCalibration.entailmentThresholdCandidates: observed entailment scores plus fixed grid 0.50..0.99
developmentCalibration.thresholdSelection: Among boundaries satisfying every safety gate and removing at least one false/wrong admission, select highest entailment threshold then highest margin; development only.

distinctionFromPriorExperiments: #71 used extractive QA alone as a veto; this candidate requires a separately pinned multilingual NLI entailment decision and treats QA only as a span proposal.
#102/#103 used QA→NLI only after deterministic abstention to create rescues; this candidate never creates support and only revalidates legacy PASSAGE_* admissions.
#105 used a generative reader over a BGE shortlist and could create semantic supports; this candidate is non-generative and subset-only.
#100 removed PASSAGE_* authority wholesale with no replacement; this candidate gives each existing PASSAGE_* admission a source-bound semantic revalidation path.
